relevance.rationale: JOIN CONFIRMED from front matter: the document self-identifies as arXiv:1611.09182v1 and its title page matches the registered entry's title, author and thesis type. Metadata mismatch for references.ts to resolve (not for this ledger): the title page's degree/copyright date differs by one year from the date recorded on the entry. CITATION STATE: a true bib orphan — zero sites in content/ and zero in computations/, despite the registered entry naming its intended use (a literature route for the SU(3)-colour and hypercharge beans). RELEVANCE: it constructs one-generation Standard Model structure from R (x) C (x) H (x) O, obtaining SU(3) x U(1) as the unbroken stabilizer inside C (x) O with the correct electric charges from a number operator. That is precisely the construction conj:sm-colour-stabilizer-action already paraphrases in prose — that block describes su(3) = ker(ev_e) as the Gunaydin-Gursey colour subalgebra acting on O = C + C^3 — and precisely the gap conj:sm-hypercharge-invariant names (a second invariant giving Y). Held at supporting rather than core: QOU's open content is an action on its own three-strand Hecke state space, which this document does not supply, and its charge assignment is read off a number operator on an octonionic module rather than derived from braid data, so it is a parallel construction rather than a result QOU can consume.

keyResults.locator: Ch. on C (x) O and the colour stabilizer
keyResults.statement: SU(3) x U(1) arises as the subgroup of the C (x) O structure stabilizing a chosen unit imaginary octonion, with electric charge given by a number operator producing the correct one-generation charge spectrum.
keyResults.useForFolio: The literature precedent conj:sm-colour-stabilizer-action already paraphrases without citing, and the closest existing route to the hypercharge datum conj:sm-hypercharge-invariant declares missing.
